sections.heading: Function
paragraphs: MLLT6 encodes a nuclear protein containing PHD/zinc-finger domains and a leucine zipper, features commonly found in proteins involved in chromatin regulation and transcriptional control. Its functions include, histone and nucleosome binding, regulation of RNA polymerase II-mediated transcription, interaction with DOT1L (Dot1a), a histone methyltransferase that controls H3K79 methylation. MLLT6 can alter DOT1L localization and thereby influence gene expression, and regulation of epithelial sodium channel (ENaC) expression in kidney cells. [xxx., 2024].
